agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario is single body dropping from y=3.4 with e=1.0, dt~0.0308, gravity 9.81. Before floor bounce (step 24) downward speed 7.25 gives energy ~32.95 J (below E0). After bounce (step 25) upward speed 8.62 gives energy 42.34 J exceeding allowed 41.69 J (E0 33.35). With e=1 collision should conserve/dissipate energy, but impulse plus positional correction with large dt/substeps (7-8 substeps) injects ~9.4 J, increasing speed magnitude across bounce. Lowering restitution removes excess.
